content: Sam's GS Stash Cigars is a brand of hand-crafted premium cigars owned by the Black Cat Cigar Company. The brand was initially created by José Pepín García for the personal use of the company's owner. Production was later expanded, and the cigars were made available to the public in late 2006 or early 2007. These cigars are manufactured at the El Rey de los Habanos factory, located in the Little Havana neighborhood of Miami, Florida. The cigars feature an oily Nicaraguan Corojo wrapper, with Nicaraguan tobacco also used for both the filler and binder. They are classified as full-bodied cigars. The cigars are sold unbanded and are available in bundles of 5 or 10, as well as in a wheel of 50.
